feature: Semantic footnote/endnote body previews with source-preserving Follow
checks: Long-note preview excludes neighboring notes and chapter text
Inline extraction retains original UTF-8 source offsets and styled content
Namespace aliases and scoped bindings; group tokens excluded
Nested and empty parser boundaries; oversized attributes rejected
Preview leaves saved state and source position unchanged
Cooperative Follow retains full source document, including trailing content; Back returns to origin
limitations: Extraction retains a full source chapter and a truncated copy; physical heap qualification outstanding
Chapter parsing and copy remain synchronous
Native smoke covers existing note-reference UI and Follow/Back; semantic body boundaries are covered by dedicated host tests
Semantic markers on image elements themselves do not create note containers
No claim of physical input/display or memory qualification
